label: PF Backlog 592
title: Verify small/medium/large profiles on MyToDo (no over-scope) + close BI-PF-1333
body:
## Problem / why
BI-PF-1333 observed design over-production (19 FRs + 15 NFRs + 13 US + 314KB partial) for ONE trivial feature on MyToDo with no enforced cap; no proof the guardrails hold.
## Goal & value
Prove a trivial run stays proportionate per profile and close BI-PF-1333.
## In scope
- Run the design/architect stage for MyToDo (or a scoped simulation) with the gates in enforce mode and the small profile.
## Acceptance criteria
- design/architect output stays within the required section set + size budget for the small profile (no 19-FR / 314KB over-run).
- Evidence linked on BI-PF-1333; item closed.
## Approach
Run with PIPELINE_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=enforce + small profile; record counts/size.
